title: College Football
description:
Indiana at Michigan
No. 6 Indiana (6-1) visits Michigan (4-2) at Michigan Stadium in a Big Ten matchup. Michigan beat Penn State 21-18 and looks to quarterback Bryce Underwood, while Indiana fell 19-15 to Ohio State and relies on Josh Hoover, who has 18 TDs this season.

The Falcons host the 49ers in NFL regular-season play at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. San Francisco arrives unbeaten at 6-0 and winners of six straight, while Atlanta sits at 2-4 after back-to-back losses with 31-23 being the most recent loss to Chicago.
